name: People Data Labs
description: People, company, search, cleaning, autocomplete, IP, job-title, skill, job-posting, changelog, and privacy APIs (27 production operations).

pdl_id.description: The PDL ID of the person to enrich

name.description: The person's full name, at least first and last

location.description: A location in which a person lives

street_address.description: A street address in which the person lives

locality.description: A locality in which the person lives

region.description: A state or region in which the person lives

country.description: A country in which the person lives

postal_code.description: The postal code where the person lives. If there is no value for country, the postal code is assumed to be US

company.description: A name, website, or social url of a company where the person has worked

school.description: A name, website, or social url of a university or college the person has attended

phone.description: A phone number the person has used

email.description: An email the person has used

email_hash.description: A SHA-256 or MD5 email hash

profile.description: A social profile the person has used. https://docs.peopledatalabs.com/docs/social-networks

birth_date.description: The person's birth date: either the year or a full birth date in the format YYYY-MM-DD

data_include.description: A comma-separated string of fields that you would like the response to include. Begin the string with a - if you would instead like to exclude the specified fields. If you would like to exclude all data from being returned, use data_include=""

pretty.description: Whether the output should have human-readable indentation

min_likelihood.description: The minimum likelihood score that a response must have in order to count as a match

include_if_matched.description: If set to true, includes a top-level (alongside "data", "status", etc) field "matched" which includes a value for each queried field parameter that was "matched-on" during our internal query.

required.description: The fields a response must have in order to count as a match

titlecase.description: Setting titlecase to true will titlecase the person data in 200 responses.
